title: Ojas Kumar
text:
Discover Elementary Number Theory
I am a coauthor, with Gaurav Bhatnagar and Sagar Shrivastava, of Discover Elementary Number Theory. The book grew out of a course we taught for the Lodha Genius Programme in 2024, based loosely on Hardy and Wright’s An Introduction to the Theory of Numbers. Our aim was to break some of its ideas into sequences of problems that students could work through for themselves. The students worked through a new problem sheet each day, and were largely Ashoka undergraduates interning with the programme.

title: Ojas Kumar
text:
Ojas Kumar ओजस कुमार


Research Associate Safexpress Centre for Data, Learning and Decision Sciences


ojas.kumar@ashoka.edu.in · ojaskumar00@gmail.com




I am a Research Associate at SCDLDS, where I am part of the finance group. I work at the intersection of quantitative finance and machine learning, and I am particularly interested in portfolio optimization.
I studied at Ashoka University as an undergraduate before completing a master’s degree in mathematics at the Chennai Mathematical Institute in 2025. I found my way back to Ashoka soon after, but this time as a researcher.
I enjoy teaching. I have taught at Ashoka as a Teaching Fellow and have returned to the Lodha Genius Programme for about a month each summer over the past four years—first as an intern, and for the past two summers as Visiting Faculty.

title: Ojas Kumar
text:
Master’s thesis
The Laguerre–Pólya Class, Jensen Polynomials and the Riemann Hypothesis
Chennai Mathematical Institute · 2025
Supervisor: Siddhi Pathak
This was an expository project on the Laguerre–Pólya class and the Jensen-polynomial approach to the Riemann hypothesis. As part of the project, I also translated Pólya and Schur’s 1914 paper Über zwei Arten von Faktorenfolgen in der Theorie der algebraischen Gleichungen from German into English.
